stem:
The table shows the number of gallons of gasoline in a car's gas tank after the car has been driven x miles.

Gasoline Usage

| Miles Driven, x | Gallons of Gasoline in Tank, y |
|---|---|
| 0 | 15 |
| 10 | 14.6 |
| 20 | 14.2 |
| 35 | 13.6 |
| 60 | 12.6 |
| 75 | 12 |

When these data are graphed on a coordinate grid, the points all lie on the same line. What are the slope and y-intercept of this line?
visual_elements: Table titled 'Gasoline Usage' with columns 'Miles Driven, x' and 'Gallons of Gasoline in Tank, y' containing values (0,15), (10,14.6), (20,14.2), (35,13.6), (60,12.6), (75,12)
